title: A dihybrid cross: RrYy × RrYy
caption: Each parent makes four gamete types, RY, Ry, rY and ry, in equal numbers because the genes assort independently. The 16 squares give the 9 : 3 : 3 : 1 phenotype ratio, and each gene on its own still gives 3 : 1.
alt: A four by four Punnett square of two plants heterozygous for seed shape and seed colour, giving nine round yellow, three round green, three wrinkled yellow and one wrinkled green.
description: Each parent is RrYy: round and yellow.
Gametes: RY, Ry, rY and ry, each one quarter.
Phenotypes 9 round yellow : 3 round green : 3 wrinkled yellow : 1 wrinkled green.
